name: ck-code
description: Spec-driven workflow plugin: design -> plan -> build -> ship. Transforms specs into architecture docs, epics/stories, and auto-generated expert and language-guide skills tailored to your tech stack. Story state lives in frontmatter; indexes are generated.

model_fast.title: Fast tier model
model_fast.description: Model alias dispatched for trivial mechanical stories and QA command runs. One of: haiku, fable, sonnet, opus.

model_balanced.title: Balanced tier model
model_balanced.description: Default model alias for a story implementer in /ck-code:build PARALLEL MODE. One of: haiku, fable, sonnet, opus.

model_advanced.title: Advanced tier model
model_advanced.description: Model alias for stories with a high-reasoning signal — novel algorithm, concurrency correctness, security- or perf-critical path. One of: haiku, fable, sonnet, opus.
